vulnerability.name: USN-9181-1
vulnerability.description: It was discovered that the JGSS component of OpenJDK 8 did not correctly authenticate users. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to read or modify sensitive data. (CVE-2026-114939)  Nicholas Carlini discovered that the JSSE component of OpenJDK 8 did not correctly authorize users. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to read or modify sensitive data. (CVE-2026-114940)  It was discovered that the Hotspot component of OpenJDK 8 did not correctly authorize users. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service or to modify sensitive data. (CVE-2026-114943)  Alexander Dezhinov, Stanislav Dukhin, Nikita Kozlov, and Binbin Xu discovered that the Core Java Libraries component of OpenJDK 8 did not correctly authorize users. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to modify sensitive data. (CVE-2026-114944)  It was discovered that the Compiler component of OpenJDK 8 did not correctly authorize users. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to read or modify sensitive data. (CVE-2026-114946)  In addition to security fixes, the updated packages contain bug fixes, new features, and possibly incompatible changes.  Please see the following for more information: https://openjdk.org/groups/vulnerability/advisories/2026-11-17

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in OpenJDK 8.
